prompt: Compose an original complete 60-second instrumental cue for uplifting architecture and open landscapes. Instruments: clean guitar harmonics, bass, restrained acoustic drums. 120 BPM in 4/4. Motif: a rising fourth followed by a descending step. Start the hook and beat immediately; maintain a clear pulse and concise two-bar phrases. One fresh timbral answer halfway through. Keep the groove throughout, then a decisive tonic ending during the last second with a very short natural decay. No slow intro, long outro, riser, silence or fade-out. Mobile-speaker-friendly bass. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. No imitation of any artist, song, film, game or brand.
